newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER - FEYENOORD SIGN TWO SOUTH AMERICANS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - FEYENOORD SIGN TWO SOUTH AMERICANS.

text.p: Dutch title-chasers Feyenoord Rotterdam have signed two players during their training camp in South America.
Argentine striker Bustos Montoya, 20, of Rosario and Uruguayan defender Fernando Olvaro Picun, 24, of River Plate Montevideo, both signed five-and-a-half year contracts.
"We've done a good deal," Feyenoord coach Arie Haan said on Sunday. "In terms of the price versus quality ratio we could never have clinched this double deal in the Netherlands or Europe."

Rosario has already proved a fruitful source of recruitment for Feyenoord, as defender Patricio Graff and midfielder Pablo Sanchez came to Rotterdam from the Argentine club and have become regular first team players.
Feyenoord, currently second in the Dutch premier league, return to the Netherlands on Wednesday in preparation for the resumption of league action in February.
